chunks: Muhammad b. Ali Majiluwayh (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Yahya al-Attar narrated to us. He said: Ja'far b. Muhammad al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Zayd narrated to us from Abdullah b. al-Fadl from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: On the night I was made to travel to heaven, my Lord — Mighty is His majesty — spoke to me and said: 'O Muhammad!' So I said: 'I am at Your service, my Lord.'

So He said: Indeed, Ali is My Proof over My creation after you. He is the Imam of the people of My obedience. Whoever obeys him has obeyed Me, and whoever disobeys him has disobeyed Me. Therefore, establish him as a sign for your Nation so that they may be guided through him after you.

key_terms.جَلَّ جَلَالُهُ: Jalla jalaluhu — 'Mighty is His majesty'; honorific formula for God
key_terms.حُجَّة: Hujjah — divine proof or authority, a title designating the Imam as God's representative on earth
key_terms.طَاعَة: Ta'a — obedience; the doctrinal principle that obedience to the Imam is equivalent to obedience to God
key_terms.عَلَم: 'Alam — a sign or banner; used metaphorically for the Imam as a guiding landmark for the community
key_terms.لَبَّيْك: Labbayk — 'Here I am' / 'I am at your service'; a response to a divine or honorific call

ai.seo_question: What did God say to the Prophet Muhammad during the Night Journey about Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a divine command received by the Prophet Muhammad during the Night Journey (Isra' wa Mi'raj), wherein God explicitly designated Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS) as the hujjah (divine proof/authority) and Imam over all of creation after the Prophet. The declaration that obedience to Ali equals obedience to God and disobedience to Ali equals disobedience to God establishes the theological and political authority of the Imam. This narration is central to Shia doctrine of the Imamate and is transmitted through Imam al-Sadiq from a chain ascending to the Prophet himself.
